audit.why: Karma bullies 1-2 with a level-1 Mantra and 950-range Inner Flame; 3 through 5 are even because one Rupture flips a trade; 6 onward is Feast.
audit.corrected: Karma / Karma / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Skill — the mirror's chart and the packet chart, matching every why already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization tells you to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain' and offers armour/MR as the scaling answer; nothing states that Feast's damage is true.

audit.corrected: Anti-heal line replaced with the true-damage warning; Feral Scream's silence (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 300 range) is why the shield sometimes never gets cast.
